quarterly_data.quarter: Tenstorrent press release: PFN and Tenstorrent Selected for NEDO Project on "xPU (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Preferred Networks (PFN) and Tenstorrent USA announced on October 21, 2026 that their joint proposal was selected by Japan's New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) for the theme 'xPU Design and Development Incorporating Photonics-Electronics Integration Technology' under its Post-5G infrastructure / advanced-semiconductor manufacturing technology R&D project (no amount stated). The five-year R&D program covers system integration technologies for AI processors using photonics-electronics integration and advanced packaging (PFN and Tenstorrent), AI chiplets with ultra-high memory bandwidth through 3D memory stacking on leading-edge process technologies (PFN), and open-architecture CPU chiplets that support confidential computing (Tenstorrent; the CPU-chiplet design and confidential-computing software work is subcontracted to Tenstorrent Japan). The companies will then work to commercialize the results for applications including AI agents.
